Subject: Payband exception request: Sr Kernel Engineer (Amit Verma) — comp & leveling sign-off

Team —

Quick ask to get alignment and a short signoff so we can move to offer. Amit Verma (referred by Rebecca Lin at Ambra) finished final loop last week; hiring panel recommends IC5 (Sr) due to systems design depth + kernel work. Compensation request is above our published IC5 midpoint. Specifics below: 

- Role: Senior Kernel Engineer, Runtime (IC5)
- Candidate: Amit Verma — current: Ambra Labs (Senior Systems Engineer)
- Proposed: base $220,000 + 15% target bonus + RSU grant of $180k 4yr
- Ask: exception to payband midpoint (need approval to go to $220k base; our IC5 midpoint is $190k)

Rationale (panel): strongly positive on latency-sensitive design, has kernel-level performance wins, and would unblock multiple ship-critical projects in H2. We think this is a rare hire and aligned to comp band exceptions we made last year for similarly scarce skills.

Please reply with: (a) approve within current signoff limits, (b) approve with exec escalation required, or (c) decline — and indicate next steps. If approved, I will circulate offer memo for legal/HR routing. Attaching a draft offer memo and the comp band chart for reference.

Thanks —
Chloe Martin

Appreciate the quick responses — finalizing here. Level justification below (to attach to the offer memo):

- Candidate demonstrated design for low-latency kernel modules and has shipped 2 production kernel patches that reduced p99 by >30% at Ambra.
- Will own core KV cache / eviction policy and contribute to serving kernel optimizations across products (cross-team impact).
- Interview panel agreed candidate meets IC5 bar based on system design, takeover examples, and mentor/lead indicators.

Final numbers for routing: Base $220,000; Target bonus 15% ($33,000); RSU grant $180,000 (4y). Total first-year cash+equity ~ $433,000. No relocation or sign-on requested.

Lauren — per your note, please confirm exec routing for >$210k base. If approved, I'll send the offer memo and ask Marissa to push DocuSign.
